ideas.pitch: An agent that ingests Norwegian company registries, matches disparate mentions using semantic embeddings and entity resolution, and outputs verified facts with timestamped evidence links to prevent cross-company data contamination.
ideas.title: Norwegian Company Graph & Evidence Deduplicator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Scoring heavily weights matching information correctly with evidence (30 points) and avoiding material wrong-company publications, which cause immediate disqualification.

ideas.pitch: An agent designed to process 1,000+ Norwegian company profiles by querying official public APIs, verifying financial figures against historical records to catch fabricated values, and maintaining current profiles.
ideas.title: Autonomous Norwegian Registry Crawler & Incremental Updator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the required scale of at least 1,000 company profiles and the 20-point scoring allocation for keeping profiles current and avoiding fabricated values.

ideas.pitch: An agent that uses dual-pass validation—where a secondary critic model checks extracted company facts against raw public source text and source dates before saving them to the profile store.
ideas.title: Self-Correcting Norwegian Company Fact-Checking Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the 'adversarial self-improving' win pattern, reducing the risk of material wrong-company publication or hallucinations.

ideas.pitch: A containerized CLI tool that executes parallel discovery loops over Norwegian public registers, builds a structured dataset of 1,000 companies, validates evidence links, and outputs exact run cost metrics.
ideas.title: One-Command Norwegian Company Intelligence Pipeline
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly fulfills the strict submission requirements of a single command to run, exact commit hash, model/API details, and expected run cost disclosures.

ideas.pitch: An agent that not only fetches facts and source links for Norwegian companies but also generates clear natural language explanations detailing why each specific data point was extracted and how it was verified.
ideas.title: Explainable Company Profiler with Audit Trails
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the 10-point allocation for giving useful explanations and the 5-point 'easy to use' score by building robust inspection tooling into the CLI output.
